server_implementation: Python standard-library HTTPServer; single-threaded dedicated frontend_bridge package
content_version_policy: Required explicit literal 4.4.54; no latest/fallback; fail startup on version/identity disagreement or unavailable DB/authority
options_policy: Known routes, exact allowed Origin, declared route method and Content-Type header only
response_document_policy: Verbatim authority fields serialized by backend stable_bytes; no envelope/decorations
request_json_policy: Buffered exact Content-Length; reject transfer encoding, duplicate keys, nonstandard constants, malformed UTF-8/JSON; root object required

origin_policy.allowlist_cli: Repeated --allow-origin replaces defaults, validated local localhost/127.0.0.1 origin only
origin_policy.host_header_gate: Exactly one Host matching localhost/127.0.0.1 and actual listening port; denies DNS rebinding hosts
origin_policy.authentication_reason: Loopback-only, stateless, read/compute only; exact local Origin allowlist and JSON POSTs; no execution or filesystem mutation

error_sanitization: Fixed safe transport messages; no exception text, tracebacks, paths, SQLite/registry location, env values or stack frames; request/error logs suppressed

concurrency.inspection: ContentDatabase creates short-lived sqlite3 connections per query; registry immutable; no explicitly guaranteed concurrent stack access

scenario_package_decoder.hash_policy: Hash shape only in import guard; original JSON sent to P4 for hash validation; no browser hash calculation

frontend_client.wire_fidelity: Original compiler JSON text held in private WeakMap outside document; support transmits verbatim to preserve Python float spellings and P4 hash; edited/no-source packages rejected

fixture_policy: Explicit 4.4.54 public authority outputs, test-only; no production defaults or public browsing asset changes

backend.command: Python 3.13.14 sys.path=[src,repo]; python -m unittest -v tests.frontend_bridge.test_server tests.game_data.test_scenario_compiler tests.game_data.test_scenario_contract_conformance tests.game_data.test_scenario_entity_resolution_parity tests.product_support.test_scenario_support_report tests.frontend_adapter.test_product_render tests.frontend_adapter.test_render tests.game_data.test_content_product tests.game_data.test_stage_product

live_native_fetch.transport: Real FE3 client via Vite SSR + native fetch -> real loopback Python HTTPServer

tests.cli_help: PASS; required --content-version 4.4.54, --port and local --allow-origin; no --host option

handoff.scope: Only listed CR-owned additive files plus manifest.json
handoff.manifest: Per-file byte size and SHA-256; archive reopened and every entry verified
